entities.name: Aminomethyltransferase B2RI74
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Porphyromonas gingivalis aminomethyltransferase B2RI74; length 362 aa.
Annotated EC 2.1.2.10; GO:0004047 aminomethyltransferase activity; associated with glycine cleavage complex and cytosol.
Pfam domains: GCV_T PF01571 (positions 7–260) and GCV_T_C PF08669 (positions 283–360).

entities.name: Aminomethyl transfer to THF
observations: Transfers the aminomethyl group from lipoyl-bound aminomethyl-dihydrolipoamide to tetrahydrofolate, producing dihydrolipoamide, 5,10-methylene-THF, and ammonium; EC 2.1.2.10, Rhea RHEA:16945.

entities.name: Glycine cleavage system
observations: Aminomethyltransferase is the T protein component of the glycine cleavage system, which degrades glycine; reference annotation places it in the glycine cleavage complex.
